note: Snapshot of public ratings, entered by hand. Not live data. Per-place values and their source URLs live in places.json under ratings.

google.label: Google Maps
google.method: Rating and review count read from the Google Maps place panel in a browser.

tripadvisor.label: Tripadvisor
tripadvisor.method: Rating and review count of the Tripadvisor listing as shown in web search results for that listing URL.

combined: Weighted mean by review count: sum(value*count)/sum(count). A platform without a rating or count is left out.
